headline: OpenAI slows Astra model development due to security concerns, while Cloudflare launches Kitesurf, a browser for AI agents
tldr: Today's AI news is dominated by security concerns and new launches. OpenAI has slowed the development of its Astra model due to cybersecurity threats, while Cloudflare has introduced Kitesurf, a browser designed for AI agents. Additionally, ByteDance is training a massive AI model to rival Anthropic, and Instacart has built an AI-powered assistant to help on-call engineers investigate incidents.

new_models.title: ByteDance trains massive AI model in bid to rival Anthropic
new_models.summary: ByteDance is training a massive AI model with 10 trillion parameters to rival Anthropic.
new_models.why_it_matters: This development highlights the ongoing competition in the AI landscape, with companies racing to create more powerful models.
